name: vectors-live-offline
command:
set -e
trap "docker compose -p foundry-rc-vectors down -v" EXIT
docker compose -p foundry-rc-vectors up -d
for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:58080/v1/.well-known/ready; then break; fi
sleep 1
done
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:58080/v1/.well-known/ready
WEAVIATE_ACCEPTANCE=1 bundle exec ruby test/weaviate_service_test.rb
bundle exec rubocop
